title: Text show prints every note in full on request: show REF --notes, oldest first, within the response budget with an exact omitted count
outcome: Text show prints every note in full on request: show REF --notes, oldest first, within the response budget with an exact omitted count
acceptance: show REF --notes (CLI and MCP notes flag) prints all notes oldest first in full text within the agent response budget and reports the exact notes_omitted remainder; default show keeps its terse latest-note line; documented in cli-and-mcp

completion.summary: Full-note CLI/MCP read preserves whole oldest-first inherited/native note bodies and exact refs within final budgets, with exact omitted count. Review fixes frame refs, preserve absent-or-array omissions, bound tiny-note candidates and binary-search fitting, share typed gate validation/formatting, and cover child/cross-project/inherited-only paths.
